interpretation_limits: This is timing for one saved episode on this machine and software state; it is not a general benchmark.
Baseline and safety policies take different actions and have different episode lengths; total wall-time differences combine added sensing with the changed action/step count.
Emergency sensor scan time is the direct added sensor cost; the per-step and end-to-end comparisons are descriptive.
One warmup and alternating five paired measurements reduce but do not eliminate OS scheduling and thermal variability.

measurement_method.emergency_sensor_scan: wall time around one full IndependentEmergencySafetySensor.scan call; includes MuJoCo pose synchronization, forward kinematics, ray traversal, grid rasterization, tracking, and record creation
measurement_method.episode_total: wall time around scenario/scene/sensor construction plus run_episode; excludes artifact writing and source file loading
measurement_method.instrumentation: same wrappers are present for both conditions; all measurements are observational and do not alter actions or observation schedules
measurement_method.nested_timing_note: ray-pipeline and controller timings are subsets of episode core and are not additive to episode time
measurement_method.pair_order: alternates baseline-first and safety-first to reduce order bias
measurement_method.run_episode_core: wall time inside the evaluator call, including initial observation, simulated steps, collision checks, contact accounting, and metric calculation
